name: Sentinel x402 Per-Agent Spend Governance — Invoica Staging

package_status.author: Valeo
package_status.main_api: wrapWithSentinel(fetch, config) — wraps fetch for automatic x402 payment tracking
package_status.note: Package IS published on npm. Install command is unblocked.

invoica_integration.integration_approach: wrapWithSentinel() wraps the fetch instance used inside ClawRouter calls. Each ClawRouter response already surfaces costUsdc (from X-Payment-Amount header via clawrouter-client.ts). Sentinel intercepts at the fetch layer — no changes to orchestrate-agents-v2.ts required for basic policy enforcement. Advanced integration: call buildSentinelConfig(policy) once per agent at orchestrator startup; replace raw fetch with the Sentinel-wrapped variant for that agent's callClawRouter scope.
invoica_integration.hook_point: scripts/lib/clawrouter-client.ts — wrap the internal httpRequest fetch at module init. Alternatively, instrument the three walletState.spentThisMonth += crResult.costUsdc sites in orchestrate-agents-v2.ts (lines 675, 1438, 1616, 1931) to also call a sentinel trackSpend() side-channel after existing wallet-state save.
invoica_integration.audit_format: JSONL, one record per x402 payment, HMAC-signed via FileStorage. Each record includes: agentId, endpoint, tx_hash, amount_usdc, policy_result (PASS/WARN/BLOCK), timestamp.
invoica_integration.storage_backend: FileStorage (local, rotateDaily: true). Upgrade path: ApiStorage → sentinel.valeocash.com dashboard for cross-run aggregation.
invoica_integration.init_order: 1. initSentinelStorage() at orchestrator process start. 2. For each agent task, buildSentinelConfig(policy) to get per-agent config. 3. wrapWithSentinel(fetch, config) scoped to that agent's LLM calls.
invoica_integration.existing_wallet_state: Invoica already tracks spentThisMonth (monthly, team-level) in logs/wallet/state.json via wallet-state.ts. Sentinel complements this with per-agent DAILY caps and HMAC-signed immutable audit records — not a replacement.

team_ceiling_note: Sum of per-agent daily caps = 225 USDC. Enforce via Sentinel team field 'invoica-core' + aggregate query on audit log at day boundary.

sentinel_api_summary.spike_detection: Flags payments exceeding spikeThreshold × rolling average. spikeThreshold is a numeric multiplier (e.g., 3.0). The spikeAlertPercent in AGENT_BUDGET_POLICIES maps to multiplier via: multiplier = spikeAlertPercent / 10.
sentinel_api_summary.error_class: SentinelBudgetError with violation.type and violation.limit fields

satoshi_treasury_integration.audit_trail_format: JSONL at logs/sentinel/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Each line: { agentId, endpoint, amount_usdc, policy_result, tx_hash, timestamp }. FileStorage writes are HMAC-signed — tamper-evident.
satoshi_treasury_integration.morning_report_hook: Satoshi's morning treasury report (run-cfo.ts) should: (1) read logs/sentinel/$(date +%Y-%m-%d).jsonl at startup, (2) aggregate per-agent daily totals, (3) flag any WARN or BLOCK records, (4) compare each agent's total vs dailyCapUSDC from AGENT_BUDGET_POLICIES, (5) compare team total vs TEAM_DAILY_CEILING_USDC=225, (6) include sentinel summary section in Telegram report.
satoshi_treasury_integration.query_api: FileStorage supports query by agentId and time range — use audit.query({ agentId: 'satoshi', since: startOfDay }) for per-agent slice.
satoshi_treasury_integration.export_formats: CSV and JSON export available via audit logger for monthly reconciliation.

invoica_agent_mapping.note: Invoica uses agent directory names (ceo, cfo, cto, etc.), not the Kognai names. TICKET-022 caps apply to the Kognai swarm agents operating inside the Invoica project scope.

agentId_mapping.sherlock: Quality gate / audit agent (lower cap, longer spike window — expected slow burn)
agentId_mapping.satoshi: CFO treasury agent — also the consumer of audit data

env_vars_required.name: SENTINEL_HMAC_SECRET
env_vars_required.description: Secret key for HMAC-signed audit records. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

env_vars_required.name: SENTINEL_SPONSOR_EMAIL
env_vars_required.description: Human sponsor email for high-value approval requests
